questions.en: Which country had the most World Heritage sites as of 2016?

timeline.labelEn: Italy leads the UNESCO World Heritage List with 51 sites as of 2016, ahead of China (50)
timeline.labelDe: Italien führt 2016 die UNESCO-Welterbeliste mit 51 Stätten an, vor China (50)

questions.notes: Card statement is false (Greece had 18 sites by 2016). Counted from the inscription years in the de.wikipedia lists: Italy 51, China 50, Spain 45, Greece 18 sites inscribed up to 2016. China later drew level (both 55 in 2019).
